fields.label: It is a pricing problem, not a technical one
paragraphs: 🛑 FKM is not wrong for an oil filler cap — it is more than most of them need. NBR has been the standard oil-seal compound for decades and handles hot oil and oil vapour at filler-neck temperatures. FKM earns its place where the engine runs hotter than NBR’s +120 °C, and there it is the right call.
But FKM costs 2–3× NBR, and on a part ordered in tens of thousands that is the difference between winning and losing the enquiry. Opening the selector on it quotes the premium to everyone.
Margo produces every part in every compound it mixes (client-instructed 2026-09-02). Nothing is removed — the eight are ranked, and the default moves to NBR.

sections.title: From compound to certification
sections.live: LIVE H2 → From Compound to Certification · six steps · “compression moulding” is right on this page

fields.label: Steps
rows: Material compounding — polymer blending, additive integration and batch QC in our in-house lab. Compression set at temperature is set here — it is the property an O-ring lives or dies on.
Mould design and CNC tool manufacture, in-house, held as a controlled record. Multi-cavity tooling — O-rings are made hundreds at a time.
Compression moulding — [no change; correct on this part]
Post-cure and deflashing — the parting line is the seal face on an O-ring, so flash removal is the step that decides whether it seals.
Quality inspection — inside diameter, cross-section and surface quality checked against ISO 3601-1 and -3, plus hardness and batch sampling.
Export packaging — industrial packing with documentation. Bagged by size code so the ring can be identified after delivery. ISPM-15 treated pallets where timber is used.
fields.note:
Six steps, six kept, and the process named is the process used — third sheet running.
Step 04 is the one worth the clause. On most mouldings flash is cosmetic; on an O-ring the parting line runs around the sealing surface, and a supplier who says so has clearly made them.
Step 05 turns two standards from marketing into inspection procedure, which is what makes the rest of the page credible
